note: `uses` measured GAP -> implemented. `use Mod` is Elixir's mixin application (Mod.__using__/1 runs inside the using module and injects code into it) — the same claim dart records for `class A extends B with M1, M2` with metadata isMixin. Measured: 509 `use` sites in 324 of 559 corpus files -> 504 `uses` edges in 321 files, 504/504 sources resolving. It is NOT a relabelling of `references`: both edges are emitted from the same directive, because the module dependency is a separate true statement (517 corpus sites would have been deleted with it). The member-read reading of `uses` (the dominant family definition: dart/c/erlang/clean/clojure use it for `x.field`) was measured and REFUSED for Elixir — a member read carries no type on the receiver, so the target would be a bare field name resolving by coincidence. Falsifier: mutant elixir/uses-self-loop, elixir/uses-drops-references, elixir/uses-group-collapsed.
